init_config_review.instruction: Configure the approved iCloud SMTP sender and one development test inbox. Credentials stay in the desktop OS credential store and are supplied only to the declared delivery worker at launch.

fields.label: Enable Development Email Delivery
fields.description: Allows the reviewed development-send step to run. Every email still requires a separate explicit approval for that run.

fields.label: SMTP Server
fields.description: Outbound iCloud mail server. imap.mail.me.com on port 993 is only for reading incoming mail and is not supported here.

fields.label: SMTP Port
fields.description: The approved iCloud SMTP submission port.

fields.label: Connection Security
fields.description: GTM Assistant supports STARTTLS with smtp.mail.me.com on port 587. Optional reply monitoring uses the same approved identity through IMAP separately.

fields.label: SMTP Username / Sender Email
fields.description: The iCloud email address that authenticates with SMTP and appears as the sender.

fields.label: App-Specific Password
fields.description: An Apple app-specific password. It is encrypted in the OS credential store and never saved in the co-worker registry or configuration JSON.

fields.label: Development Recipient
fields.description: The single test inbox that may receive an explicitly approved development email. Only replies from this inbox that reference that development message are counted. This is not the sender address or a customer list.

fields.label: Send Approved Development Email
fields.description: Permits one development-only rendering check when paired with a bounded approval ID. It never authorizes customer messaging.

fields.label: Development Send Approval ID
fields.description: A bounded human approval reference for the one development-only send.

fields.label: Monitor Development Replies
fields.description: After a successful approved development send, keep the co-worker running and read only matching IMAP reply headers. No reply is ever sent automatically.

fields.label: Reply Monitor Interval (seconds)
fields.description: How often the read-only development inbox monitor checks for replies, bounded between 5 and 300 seconds.

starter_questions: What is this Job responsible for?
What progress and results are available from the latest Run?
What approval is needed before a development email can be sent?
